Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the Regency of East Barito.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and Regional Apparatus as elements of Regional Government Administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of East Barito.
4. Regional People's Representative Council hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional People's Representative Council Institution which serves as an element of Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus of East Barito Regency is the supporting element of the Regent and Regional People's Representative Council of East Barito Regency in the Administration of government affairs which are the authority of East Barito Regency.

1alJ.

Agency is the Regional Agency that handles government affairs in the field of women and children. Technical Service Unit is the Regional Technical Service Unit that handles the protection of women and children.

Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 years, including a child still in the womb. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person who is recognized by law as a Woman. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including neglect, threat of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness, and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.

15. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.

16. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.

17. Victim of acts of violence is an individual or group of people who experience physical, mental or emotional suffering, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights (HAM) violations, or criminal acts as well as acts of violence committed either by state apparatus or by the state or regional government apparatus or by individuals. 1g. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence. 19. Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process. 20. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution that has expertise in providing assistance.

21. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of acts of violence to family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.

22. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in society.

23. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, community, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.

24. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

25. Regional Action Plan hereinafter abbreviated as RAD is the foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in carrying out activities for the implementation of prevention and protection of women and children victims of acts of violence.

26. Shelter is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

27. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

28. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and laterally up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is the dependent of a woman and/or child.

Parent is a biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.

Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget hereinafter abbreviated as APBD is the annual financial plan of the Regional Government which is discussed and jointly approved by the Regional Government and DPRD and is stipulated by Regional Regulation.

Gender Equality is the view that all people should receive equal treatment and not be discriminated against based on their gender identity.

Medicolegal Service is a form of health service performed by medical personnel using medical science and technology based on the authority possessed for legal purposes and to implement applicable regulations.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF EAST BARITO REGENCY NOilIoR 5. raHuN 2019

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN DAII ANAIS

The role of women is very important because they are the mothers of the nation who are the pillars of the family to build the future of human resources in various fields including family economic empowerment, as well as children who are the nation's generation who will play a role in filling development in the future.

Children and Women must receive protection from violence, exploitation, human trafficking and neglect by responsible parties. Protection is intended to create a peaceful and prosperous atmosphere for all levels of society in fostering life and togetherness within the regional area.

Violence cannot be avoided just like that, but must be prevented as early as possible from spreading to a level that is detrimental to all parties. Protection efforts are prioritized on prevention efforts and minimizing incidents.

Acts of violence against Children and Women constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. So far, the laws and regulations governing the protection of Children and Women victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region so that institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure their implementation. Regional Regulations regulate protection efforts for victims, especially in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of Children and Women victims of violence in Kotabaru Regency. As one of the protection efforts for Children and Women, it is carried out through guidance, training and assistance to victims and families of violence victims. Economic empowerment is also carried out to prevent women as victims, which can be done by growing and developing micro and small businesses in accordance with local potential. To develop micro and small businesses, it is necessary to increase the capacity and capability of women through assistance and guidance so that women can develop their businesses.

translated_text:
Article 3

Paragraph {1) What is meant by "physical violence" is any action that results in pain, injury, wounds or defects on a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causes death.

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an action that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.

What is meant by "sexual violence" is any action in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, forced unnatural or unwanted sexual relations, forcing sexual relations with others for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.

What is meant by "exploitation" includes: actions that exploit children economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others; actions with or without the consent of the victim which b. include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.

c. all forms of utilization of sexual organs or other organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or indecency.

What is meant by "trafficking in persons" is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payments or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person who has control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
